title: Org slot triage & headcount tradeoffs (scratch)
content:
Context:
- Quick scratch for Wed 1:1 with Priya + weekly HC sync (people-ops). Not a polished doc; personal capture.
- Goal: triage interview slots, prioritize reqs for Q1 hiring commits, capture debrief actions from last 2 interview rounds.

High-level constraints / tradeoffs:
- Budget: hiring target 18 FTEs Q1 across Eng (8), Product (4), SRE (3), DX/Support (3). Can flex +/-2 depending on Dedicated product ramp.
- Timeline: commit window for reserved capacity by 2025-01-31 (sales ops asks for headcount forecast).
- Interview capacity: current panel pool = 22 engineers available (avg 3 slots/day). We must avoid >3 concurrent loops to keep quality.

Open slots (raw):
- Mon/Wed/Fri 9:30-11:00am - 3x panel slots each day (prefer backend/infra candidates)
- Tue/Thu 2:00-4:30pm - 4x panel slots (frontend/product-focused)
- Weekend: avoid scheduling unless candidate is exceptional.

Candidate pipeline notes (short IDs):
- C-102 (backend IC5) - take-home done, strong system design, flagged for final exec screen. Hiring manager: Mara. Notes: latency Qs, Redwood dedicated routing knowledge a plus.
- C-117 (infra SRE IC3) - blue team, availability Feb start, needs on-call experience. Interviewers: Kenji, Asha.
- C-131 (product PM) - great PM instincts, not enough platform experience. Hold for later (Q2).
- C-138 (embedding researcher) - leveling uncertain, schedule calibration meeting before loop.

Interview loop adjustments (proposed):
- Remove take-home for infra roles: replace with 45m paired troubleshooting session during loop (reduces time to offer by ~7 days).
- Add a short Redwood-specific prompt in loop: ask candidates how they'd optimize for cost/latency tradeoffs (ties to platform thesis).
- Standardize debrief form to include: score (1-5), risk flags, calibration note, hire/next-step. Link: HR-452.

Recent debrief snapshots (quick):
- C-102: panel scores 4/4/3, main concern: cross-team experience. Action: schedule exec screen + follow-up deep-dive on infra design (owner: Mara, due 11/22).
- C-117: panel mixed 3/2/3 - red flag on on-call rota misunderstandings. Action: schedule hands-on SRE task with Kenji (owner: Kenji, due 11/24).

Prioritization (working):
1) Backend IC5 (C-102) - high priority (revenue-impacting features + low pipeline elsewhere).
2) SRE (C-117) - medium-high (ops risk).
3) Product PM (C-131) - low for now.
4) Research/embed (C-138) - hold for leveling calibrate.

Hiring scenarios to run in sync:
- Scenario A (aggressive): fill top 10 reqs by end of Q1 -> requires 4 more interviewers (contractors) and extra scheduling windows. Cost delta: +12% headcount run-rate.
- Scenario B (conservative): hire 6 by end of Q1 -> keep current interview cadence, less risk to ramp.

Action item tracker (short, personal):
- [ ] Confirm exec screen for C-102 (owner: Mara) - note to Priya to nudge Mara in sync.
- [ ] Draft paired troubleshooting rubric for infra loops (owner: Sanjay) - due 11/26.
- [ ] Update interview calendar with blocked 'panel prep' 30m before each loop (owner: Emma) - due 11/20.
- [ ] Add cost/latency prompt to debrief template in GH (owner: Priya) - PR: slate#189 - follow up 11/21.
- [ ] Run headcount scenario A numbers and share with Finance (owner: Sanjay) - due 11/28.

Calibration notes (for 11/20 sync):
- Ask: what are non-negotiables for backend hire? (multi-team API experience, ownership of infra).
- Clarify: is level IC5 vs IC4 flexible if candidate is strong on systems? Need consensus.
- Bring: data on time-to-hire last quarter + offer acceptance rate by band (ask Finance/People analytics for latest).

Meeting agenda draft (5-15 min personal prep for Priya 1:1):
1) 5m quick pipeline status (top 3 reqs)
2) 10m triage slots + proposed loop changes (paired task, debrief form)
3) 5m approval blockers (budgets, exec screens)
4) 5m decisions & owners (confirm who nudges which hiring manager)

Notes-to-self / heuristics:
- Prefer moving faster on backend hires that unblock product roadmap.
- If panel quality drops (>=2 panels with avg score <=2.5), pause scheduling and calibrate.
- Use small rapid canary offers for top talent to reduce risk.

Misc links & refs (personal):
- Slack thread: #people-hiring - link: https://redwoodworkspace.slack.com/archives/C02HRC9T0
- Jira Epic for Q1 hires: HR-452
- Confluence headcount plan: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/HR/Headcount+Plan+Q4
- PR for debrief template: https://github.com/redwood-inference/slate/pull/189

Unresolved questions to surface in sync:
- Can hiring managers commit to >2 interviews/week through Dec? (ops capacity).
- Are we comfortable moving to paired troubleshooting vs take-home for infra (legal/comp constraints)?

Misc scratch (timestamps, quick):
- 11/18 09:10 - initial capture after reviewing panels.
- 11/19 14:05 - added C-117 note after Kenji debrief.
- 11/20 - ready to present to Priya in 1:1.

-- end scratch --
